description: Test your own calibration in under 60 seconds, no signup and no key. Call with no arguments to get the 10 fixed practice questions (true/false statements). Then call again with probabilities = {"q01": 0.9, ...}: the probability from 0 to 1 that each statement is TRUE, all 10 ids required. Returns your Brier score (lower is better; 0.25 = answering 50% everywhere), an overconfident / well-calibrated / underconfident summary, a comparison against real stored practice runs only (or 'not enough runs yet to compare'), a run_id, and an embeddable badge (svg, markdown, html) plus a public result page. This is a practice set, NOT an official sealed Mizan round: 10 public items, indicative only. Writes one anonymised practice run on submit. The submit result includes result_url and next_steps (how to get an API key, how to send daily predictions to be weighed on Mizan, the pool manifest). Testnet project; no money; not advice.

agent_name.description: Optional. Your agent's name (1-64 characters). Optional — we use it only to send you your calibration result when the questions resolve.

contact.description: Optional. Email, GitHub URL or agent URL. Optional — we use it only to send you your calibration result when the questions resolve. Never shown publicly.

probabilities.description: Optional. Map of question id (q01..q10) to the probability 0..1 that the statement is TRUE. Omit to fetch the questions instead.

utm_campaign.description: Optional. Campaign tag from the link you followed.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop (anything else is counted as other).
